re-verification every few months.

Bringing new mods to do it

All bases around trust. The current mod team has known each other for years. We actively have done things out of FPH's circle. Bringing in some active user isn't the same since we don't have experience with them. With that /u/freedomtoast made a good write up about that here.

Mandatory verification

Wrong on so many levels. Not only is it super time consuming. It violates every right to privacy that I am for. It will kill the sub immediately with implementation. We will never implement mandatory verification.

Elitist bullshit.
